description: This source file implements a priority queue data structure with functions for inserting, removing, reversing, and managing priority queue elements, along with internal helper functions for comparison and swapping.

methods.name: int compare(struct prio_queue * queue,size_t i,size_t j)
methods.description: Compares two elements in the priority queue based on a custom comparison function and a secondary counter for tie-breaking.

methods.name: void swap(struct prio_queue * queue,size_t i,size_t j)
methods.description: Swaps two elements in the priority queue array.

methods.name: void prio_queue_reverse(struct prio_queue * queue)
methods.description: Reverses the order of elements in the priority queue. Only for queues with a comparison function.

methods.name: void clear_prio_queue(struct prio_queue * queue)
methods.description: Clears and resets the priority queue.

methods.name: void prio_queue_put(struct prio_queue * queue,void * thing)
methods.description: Inserts a new element into the priority queue, maintaining the heap property if a compare function is defined.

methods.name: void sift_down_root(struct prio_queue * queue)
methods.description: Maintains the heap property by sifting down the root element.

methods.name: void * prio_queue_get(struct prio_queue * queue)
methods.description: Removes and returns the highest priority element from the queue.

methods.name: void * prio_queue_peek(struct prio_queue * queue)
methods.description: Returns the highest priority element without removing it.

methods.name: void prio_queue_replace(struct prio_queue * queue,void * thing)
methods.description: Replaces the root element of the queue, adjusting to maintain heap property.

ctags.name: compare
ctags.pattern: /^static inline int compare(struct prio_queue *queue, size_t i, size_t j)$/

ctags.name: swap
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void swap(struct prio_queue *queue, size_t i, size_t j)$/
